messages:
sam: Heads up — Acme Corp seeing repeated 502/504s hitting dedicated cluster 'eu-prod-2' since ~09:12 UTC. Affected tenant acme-42. Example Request-ID: req-8f2b7c3a. Latency spikes to 12–30s before 502. Can we get a repro bundle + node/pod logs?

mira: Thanks @sam. Can you paste the exact request-id(s) and the curl repro you used? Also if they can share the pod name or node that saw the error that helps. :eyes:

sam: Repro attempt from customer (they ran this from their infra):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "x-request-id: req-8f2b7c3a" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://eu-prod-2.api.redwood.example/v1/generate
* Connected to eu-prod-2.api.redwood.example (10.1.2.3) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: eu-prod-2.api.redwood.example
> x-request-id: req-8f2b7c3a
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream timeout","request_id":"req-8f2b7c3a"}
```

tim: Oncall SRE here. Please collect the following from the affected node/pod asap so we can triage:  
- Pod logs: `kubectl -n dedicated logs engine-5f8b9c-zzkq --all-containers --since=1h > pod-engine.log`
- Node journal: `journalctl -u kubelet --since "1 hour ago" > kubelet.log`
- Kernel messages: `dmesg -T > dmesg.txt` (capture XID messages)
- GPU snapshot: `nvidia-smi -q -x > nvidia-smi-full.xml` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,memory.used --format=csv > gpu-mem.csv`
- If permitted: `sudo nvidia-bug-report.sh --output-file /tmp/nvidia-bug-report.tar.gz`
I can assemble a debug bundle once those are uploaded.

infra-bot: Debug bundle placeholder created: s3://redwood-debug-bundles/3352109876-acme-eu-prod-2.tmp (will finalize after uploads) :package:

jess: Also ask the customer to include dcgm-exporter metrics and the runtime kvcache stats (if available) `cat /var/lib/redwood/runtime/kvcache-stats.json`. If they can reproduce, suggest running our local reproducible script:  
```
python tools/repro_client.py --host https://eu-prod-2.api.redwood.example --request-id req-8f2b7c3a --payload '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}' --repeat 3
```
Run with batch_size=1 and small concurrency to isolate the sequence that triggers the fault.

sam: Customer attached a short dmesg excerpt — they see repeated GPU allocation failures and kernel XID 79 entries: 
```
[Mon Mar 10 09:14:32 2026] NVRM: GPU 0000:03:00.0: RmInitAdapter() failed! (0x24:0x38:123)
[Mon Mar 10 09:14:32 2026] NVRM: GPU at 0000:03:00.0: Xid (79, 0x00000022, 0x00000000)
[Mon Mar 10 09:14:35 2026] gmm alloc failed: size=262144
```

tim: That Xid pattern is consistent with a driver/hardware fault or overheated/unstable GPU kernel allocation issue. Next actions: full node snapshot (trace_pipe), enable kernel driver debug flags, collect /proc/interrupts, and nvidia topology (`nvidia-smi topo -m`). If customer allows, we'll schedule a short repro window and keep the node in a controlled state (reduced other tenants) while we tail `dmesg -w` and `/sys/kernel/tracing/trace_pipe`.

mira: @tim noted. Sam — can you confirm pod name and node so I can package pod logs + request traces into the bundle? Also please confirm customer contact for a repro window.

sam: Pod name is `engine-5f8b9c-zzkq`, node `eu-gpu-node-14`. Customer confirms repro window at 10:45 UTC and will DM engineer contact. Will re-run the curl repro right before the window and upload artifacts. :pray:

infra-bot: Upload complete — finalized debug bundle: s3://redwood-debug-bundles/3352109876-acme-eu-prod-2.tar.gz (128MB). Assigned internal ticket SUP-78934. Forwarded to infra-driver-team and platform-sre.

jess: Proposed plan for the repro window: 1) set batch_size=1, concurrency=1, 2) enable kvcache debug logging, 3) run curl repro with `x-request-id` header for trace correlation, 4) simultaneously tail `dmesg -w` + trace_pipe + nvidia-smi sampling (1s). I'll be oncall for metrics.

tim: I'll prepare a canary node and enable driver debug flags ahead of the window. @mira please confirm when you've uploaded pod logs into the bundle so I can pull and sync to the canary.

sam: All set — bundle uploaded and customer confirmed 10:45 UTC. I'll DM the contact info and follow up in-channel with any immediate repro outputs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
